overview: The Outer Gates are Ka Vethan’s fortified threshold, regulating all ingress into the Akhevan capital.
history: Constructed during the earliest Akhevan settlement to protect the city’s ceremonial core.
Void‑reinforced gateworks were added after resonance instability threatened structural integrity.
Barrier pylons expanded to support Praesertum decree enforcement.
Patrol checkpoints formalized ingress regulation during early conflicts.
Modern Gates remain the first and most heavily monitored entry point into Ka Vethan.
hooks: A barrier pylon destabilizes during peak ingress.
A patrol reports void‑tainted signatures approaching the Gates.
A Praesertum directive restricts entry unexpectedly.
